description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementAPI class within the OrangeHRM system, particularly for managing leave entitlement data via RESTful API endpoints. It includes multiple methods for CRUD operations such as retrieving, creating (including bulk assign), updating, and deleting leave entitlements. The class uses traits and external services for authentication, data access, validation, and business logic. It also contains annotations for API documentation (OpenAPI).

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API operations for managing leave entitlements in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, including retrieval, creation, bulk assignment, updating, and deletion of leave entitlement records.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific leave entitlement by ID, validates access, and returns the entitlement data in the specified model format.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of leave entitlements based on query parameters such as employee number, leave type, date range, and other filters, returning paginated results along with meta information like total count and sum.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates new leave entitlement(s). Supports bulk assignment based on filter parameters and individual assignment with validation of input data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing leave entitlement identified by ID, modifying its date range and number of days.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more leave entitlement records by their IDs after validating access permissions.
